actions.extract_text.description: Get the text, headers and footers of a Word document (.docx).
actions.extract_text.props.file.descript: Pick a .docx file from an earlier step, such as an email attachment, or paste a URL to download.
actions.extract_text.props.password.desc: Only needed when the document is password-protected.
actions.fill_template.description: Fill the {{placeholders}} in a Word template (.docx) and get a new document.
actions.fill_template.props.data.descrip: Optional. A JSON object with values for the placeholders. It overrides the fields above, and is needed for a list inside a list.
actions.fill_template.props.fields.descr: One field per placeholder in the template. They appear once the template is set, or mapped from a step you have tested.
actions.fill_template.props.fileName.des: Name of the new document. Leave empty to use the template's name.
actions.fill_template.props.syntax.descr:
Type placeholders in your Word template with double braces:
- `{{name}}` is replaced by the "name" value. `{{customer.city}}` reads a nested value.
- `{{#items}}` ... `{{/items}}` repeats a table row or paragraph for each entry of the "items" list. Inside it, use the entry's fields, like `{{description}}`.
- `{{#paid}}` ... `{{/paid}}` shows the text only when "paid" is true; `{{^paid}}` ... `{{/paid}}` only when it is false or empty.
actions.fill_template.props.template.des: A .docx file with {{placeholders}}, from an earlier step or a URL.
description: Read Word documents (.docx) and fill Word templates in your flow, no Microsoft account needed.
